title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
title_zh: 强大的智能体在自主机器学习工程（MLE）中需要多复杂的“辅助框架”？

paragraphs.en: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents — where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read , write , and bash primitives — has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的自主机器学习工程（MLE）智能体在公开排行榜上取得了显著进展。 由于长期周期内进展停滞以及大型语言模型（LLM）基础能力有限，现代 MLE 智能体通常被部署在日益复杂的机制之上：例如多智能体协调器、专用检索子智能体等。 尽管这类辅助机制不断扩展，但使用更基础但经过改进的编码智能体——即 LLM 可通过 read、write 和 bash 基础操作直接访问执行环境——的做法在该领域却鲜受关注。 在本文中我们发现，在相同时间预算和相同的顶尖 LLM 架构下，开源的当前最佳辅助机制并未比最小化辅助机制的编码智能体单次运行表现出任何优势，这表明模型架构才是性能提升的主要驱动力。 通过一系列大规模的系统性消融研究，我们认为在编码智能体的设定中，这些辅助机制层已变得多余。 我们得出结论：围绕强大模型构建复杂的人工设计辅助机制，在当前 MLE 基准测试中收效甚微。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) has become a demanding testbed for LLM-based agents: solutions are open-ended ML pipelines, a single evaluation can take hours on expensive hardware, and the feedback signal — a validation score — is noisy. Since Jiang et al. (2025) framed the problem as tree search over code, the dominant design has been the harness : an outer program that queries an LLM for code, executes it, and orchestrates the exploration and combination of candidate solutions. Motivated by stagnation over long horizons and by the limits of a single LLM call, harnesses have grown steadily more elaborate, adding search trees, populations of programs, memory hierarchies, and teams of specialized agents.
paragraphs.zh: 自主机器学习工程（MLE）已成为基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的一个高要求测试平台：其解决方案是开放式的机器学习流程，单次评估在昂贵硬件上可能需要数小时，而反馈信号——即验证分数——则充满噪声。自 Jiang 等人 （2025）将问题框架为对代码的树搜索以来，主流设计一直是“harness”：一个外部程序向 LLM 查询代码、执行代码，并协调候选解决方案的探索与组合。 鉴于长期任务中的进展停滞以及单次 LLM 调用的局限性，“harness”的设计逐渐变得愈发复杂，加入了搜索树、程序种群、内存层次结构以及由专门智能体组成的团队。

paragraphs.en: Much of this machinery rests on two premises that deserve reconsideration. First, a single chat completion cannot run the code it writes, inspect the data, or react to an error, so the harness has to do it on its behalf. Modern LLMs, however, are increasingly post-trained for tool use and can operate inside coding agent environments such as OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2026 ) , where they read and write files, execute code, and debug within one self-contained session. Second, MLE is treated as a long-horizon problem that calls for dedicated memory and context management. Measured in wall-clock time, up to and beyond 24h, it is. Measured in tokens, it is less clear, now that million-token context windows are affordable. This raises a simple question: which parts of the harness still earn their keep?
paragraphs.zh: 这套机制的许多部分都建立在两个值得重新审视的前提之上。 首先，单个对话完成过程既无法运行自己编写的代码，也无法检查数据或应对错误，因此必须由外围框架代其执行这些操作。 然而，现代大型语言模型正越来越多地接受工具使用方面的后续训练，并能够在 OpenCode（OpenCode Contributors, 2026）等编码智能体环境中运行，在这些环境中，它们可以在一个自包含的会话内读取和写入文件、执行代码并进行调试。 其次，MLE 被视为一个需要专门记忆和上下文管理的长期问题。 从实际运行时间来看，其时长可达 24 小时甚至更长。 但从令牌数量来看，如今百万级令牌的上下文窗口已具备可行性，这一点则尚不明确。 这引出了一个简单的问题：外围框架的哪些部分仍然有其存在的价值？

paragraphs.en: The current literature is poorly placed to answer it. Harness performance has risen alongside backbone capability, so gains are hard to attribute to harness design. On MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , the standard testbed, published results are almost invariably reported under different backbones and hardware, seed counts rarely exceed three, and headline margins can be smaller than the run-to-run spread ( Hambardzumyan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . This is a matter of cost rather than neglect: a single 24h evaluation of three seeds over the 75 tasks already consumes thousands of GPU hours, so faithful re-runs of existing baselines are rare.
paragraphs.zh: 现有文献难以有效回答这个问题。 随着基础模型能力的提升，Harness 的性能也随之提高，因此很难将性能增益归因于 Harness 的设计。 在标准测试平台 MLE-bench（Chan 等人，2025）上，已发表的结果几乎无一例外地使用了不同的基础模型和硬件，实验种子数很少超过三个，且主要报告的性能差异可能小于单次运行之间的波动（Hambardzumyan 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026a；Yang 等人，2026）。 这更多是成本问题而非忽视：仅对 75 项任务进行三次种子为 24 小时的评估，就已经消耗了数千个 GPU 小时，因此对现有基线模型进行可靠的重复运行十分罕见。

paragraphs.en: Evidence from neighbouring domains suggests the answer may be “very little”. Across 35 releases of software-engineering harnesses, Sghaier et al. (2026) find no statistically significant improvement over a fixed backbone on SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) ; a single well-prompted agent can match multi-agent workflows ( Xu et al., 2026 ) ; multi-agent failures stem from coordination rather than capability ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Orogat et al., 2026 ) ; and orchestration can introduce substantial overhead and coordination failures ( Orogat et al., 2026 ) . Coding agents have accordingly become a standard, strong baseline in agentic evaluation ( Sghaier et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) . In MLE, however, this practice has arrived only recently ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and the coding agent comparisons reported so far are sparsely documented.
paragraphs.zh: 来自邻近领域的证据表明，答案可能是“非常有限”。在35个软件工程工具包的版本中，Sghaier等人（2026）发现，与固定主干模型相比，在SWE-bench（Jimenez等人，2024）上并未出现统计学意义上的改进；一个提示设计良好的单一智能体即可与多智能体工作流程相媲美（Xu等人，2026）；多智能体系统的失败源于协调问题，而非能力不足（Cemri等人，2025；Orogat等人，2026）；此外，编排机制可能引入显著的计算开销和协调失败（Orogat等人，2026）。因此，编码智能体已成为智能体评估中的标准且强大的基线模型（Sghaier等人，2026；Wang等人，2026a；Li等人，2026b）。然而，在最大语言模型领域，这种做法直到近期才出现（Jin等人，2026；Yang等人，2026；Chen等人，2026a；Zhao等人，2026），而目前报道的编码智能体对比研究仍缺乏充分记录。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on a harder and broader task set than Lite and, holding backbone, hardware and time budget fixed, climb a ladder of harness interventions re-implemented in a single codebase (Section 4 ): from a chat-based iteration to multi-agent coding agent orchestration. The end point of this ladder is Malena, the ma chine l earning en gineer a gent baseline: a single well-prompted coding agent session with a minimal set of tools. Giving the model a coding agent environment is by far the largest effect we measure; beyond it, no intervention significantly improves performance. We then test whether this holds for systems built specifically for MLE (Section 5 ): under matched conditions, Malena matches or outperforms four open-source state-of-the-art harnesses at every frontier backbone we test (Figure 1 ), on MLE-bench as well as on NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Finally, a trace analysis (Section 5.2 ) suggests why: the agent carries out the search these harnesses hard-code on its own, balancing rare techniques against performance-oriented refinement while reusing the artifacts it has already produced.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在比 Lite 更难、更广泛的任务集上进行评估，并在保持骨干模型、硬件和时间预算不变的前提下，通过一个由单一代码库重新实现的“工具链”干预措施阶梯逐步提升性能（第 4 节）：从基于聊天的迭代模式，发展为多智能体编码智能体的协同调度。 这一阶梯的终点是 Malena——机器学习工程师智能体的基线模型：一次经过良好提示的单一编码智能体会话，仅配备最少的工具集。 为模型提供编码智能体环境所产生的影响是我们所测得的最大效应；除此之外，没有任何其他干预措施能显著提升性能。 接着，我们测试这一结论是否适用于专为机器学习工程师（MLE）设计的系统（第 5 节）：在匹配条件下，Malena 在所有我们测试的前沿骨干模型上，其性能均与四个开源的顶尖工具链相当或更优（图 1），无论是在 MLE-bench 还是在 NatureBench（Wang et al., 2026b）上均是如此。 最后，轨迹分析（第 5.2 节）揭示了原因：该智能体能自主执行这些工具链硬编码的搜索过程，在平衡罕见技术的使用与面向性能的优化之间取得均衡，同时复用其已生成的中间产物。

paragraphs.en: A controlled, budget- and backbone-matched ablation of the intervention families common to MLE harnesses — execution environment, search, autonomy, and multi-agent orchestration — showing that the coding agent environment is the dominant factor and that no further intervention yields a statistically significant gain (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对 MLE harnesses 中共同存在的干预项（执行环境、搜索、自主性和多智能体协调）进行了受控的、预算和骨干结构匹配的消融研究，结果表明：编码智能体环境是主导因素，且任何进一步的干预都无法带来具有统计学意义的提升（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: A matched comparison against four open-source MLE harnesses on MLE-bench and NatureBench across multiple backbones, in which Malena is not outperformed at any frontier backbone (Section 5.1 ). Our results suggest that coding-agent post-training substitutes for the scaffolding that harnesses hand-design: weaker backbones still benefit from hand-crafted workflow priors, but as agentic capability grows, a plain coding agent loop closes the gap, echoing the bitter lesson ( Sutton, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在多个基础模型上，将 Malena 与四个开源 MLE 工具包在 MLE-bench 和 NatureBench 上的表现进行了匹配比较，结果表明，在任何前沿基础模型上，Malena 的性能均未落后（第 5.1 节）。 我们的研究结果表明，编码智能体的后续训练可以替代工具包中手动设计的框架：较弱的模型仍然能从手工构建的工作流先验中受益，但随着智能体能力的增强，单纯的编码智能体循环能够弥合性能差距，这与“苦涩的教训”（Sutton, 2019）不谋而合。

sents.en: A matched comparison against four open-source MLE harnesses on MLE-bench and NatureBench across multiple backbones, in which Malena is not outperformed at any frontier backbone (Section 5.1 ).
sents.zh: 在多个基础模型上，将 Malena 与四个开源 MLE 工具包在 MLE-bench 和 NatureBench 上的表现进行了匹配比较，结果表明，在任何前沿基础模型上，Malena 的性能均未落后（第 5.1 节）。

sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，编码智能体的后续训练可以替代工具包中手动设计的框架：较弱的模型仍然能从手工构建的工作流先验中受益，但随着智能体能力的增强，单纯的编码智能体循环能够弥合性能差距，这与“苦涩的教训”（Sutton, 2019）不谋而合。

paragraphs.en: A trace analysis showing that a capable coding agent performs adaptive search without harness-imposed structure (Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一项轨迹分析表明，一个能力出众的编码智能体能够在没有外部强加结构的情况下执行自适应搜索（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Jiang et al. (2025) target autonomous MLE tasks with tree search over single-file programs. Subsequent systems follow a common template: an outer harness prompts an LLM for code, and handles execution, scoring and exploration ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ; Kulibaba et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Le et al., 2026 ; Nadafian et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . The components these harnesses usually introduce cluster into a small number of claims about what LLMs cannot be trusted to do unaided.
paragraphs.zh: Jiang 等人 (2025) 针对单文件程序的树搜索来优化自主 MLE 任务。 后续系统遵循一个通用模板：一个外部框架会提示 LLM 生成代码，并处理执行、评分和探索（Yang 等人，2025；Nam 等人，2025；Fang 等人，2025；Du 等人，2025；Kulibaba 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026a；Yuan 等人，2025；Qu 等人，2026；Le 等人，2026；Nadafian 等人，2026；Choi 等人，2026；Meng 等人，2026；Fu 等人，2026）。 这些框架通常引入的组件可归为少数几个论断，即 LLM 在没有辅助的情况下无法可靠地完成某些任务。

paragraphs.en: Several systems devote their principal contribution to compressing or partitioning accumulated state ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . Most remaining interventions shape the search topology, either through validation-score-driven Monte-Carlo tree search or bandit rules ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Toledo et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , or through agent-driven hypothesis search and multi-agent orchestration ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Qiang et al., 2026 ) . Even in systems that grant agents more autonomy, the harness still largely dictates how the search should be conducted, limiting adaptability.
paragraphs.zh: 多个系统将其主要贡献用于压缩或分割累积状态（Zhu 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026；Chen 等，2026a；Jin 等，2026）。 其余大多数方法通过验证分数驱动的蒙特卡洛树搜索或多臂老虎机规则（Jiang 等，2025；Du 等，2026；Toledo 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026a），或通过智能体驱动假设搜索和多智能体协同（Chen 等，2026a；Zhao 等，2026；Jin 等，2026；Chen 等，2026b；Qiang 等，2026）来塑造搜索拓扑结构。 即使在赋予智能体更多自主权的系统中，约束机制仍然在很大程度上决定了搜索应如何进行，从而限制了适应性。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work instead modifies the backbone itself, training it for MLE with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Qiang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , supported by dedicated training and evaluation infrastructure ( Qiang et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) . However, such systems are hard to scale, given the cost of collecting 24h traces and training on such trajectories ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . In this study, we focus on the interventions present in hand-crafted harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条并行研究路线则直接修改主干本身，通过监督微调与强化学习对其进行 MLE 训练（Yang et al., 2026；Cai et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2026；Qiang et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b），并由专门的训练与评估基础设施提供支持（Qiang et al., 2025；Zou et al., 2026；Lyu et al., 2026）。 然而，鉴于收集 24 小时轨迹数据以及基于此类轨迹进行训练的成本，这类系统难以扩展（Zhou et al., 2026；Cai et al., 2026）。 在本研究中，我们重点关注手工设计的控制框架中存在的干预措施。

sents.en: In this study, we focus on the interventions present in hand-crafted harnesses.
sents.zh: 在本研究中，我们重点关注手工设计的控制框架中存在的干预措施。

paragraphs.en: We build our harness on the OpenCode v1.15.6 coding agent framework ( OpenCode Contributors, 2026 ) , and our primary benchmark is MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , with task selection described in Appendix A.1 . When reporting performance of a method that produces several submissions, we distinguish between self-selection , where the reported submission is the one with the best validation score reported by the agent, and oracle selection, where it is the one with the best hidden test score. Unless otherwise specified, we report self-selected performance. Percentile indicates the percentage of human leaderboard entries that score worse than the agent. We report 95% Confidence Intervals (CIs) on macro-task averages, holding the set of tasks fixed and bootstrapping on the seeds available for each task. Unless otherwise stated, we report results with the GLM 5.2 backbone; Appendix A.4 lists all models used. Across all experiments, agents’ resources stay fixed at 1 × \times A100 80GB, 12 CPU cores and 144GB of RAM; backbones are served locally with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工具基于 OpenCode v1.15.6 编码智能体框架（OpenCode Contributors，2026）构建，主要基准是 MLE-bench（Chan 等人，2025），任务选择方法见附录 A.1。 在报告产生多个提交结果的方法性能时，我们区分“自我选择”和“神谕选择”：前者指智能体报告的提交结果具有最高的验证分数，后者指该结果具有最高的隐藏测试分数。 除非另有说明，否则我们报告自我选择的性能。 百分位数表示得分低于该智能体的人类排行榜条目所占的百分比。 除非另有说明，我们对宏观任务平均值报告 95% 置信区间（CI），其中任务集保持固定，并对每个任务可用的种子进行自助抽样。 除非另有说明，我们报告使用 GLM 5.2 骨干模型的结果；附录 A.4 列出了所有使用的模型。 在所有实验中，智能体的资源始终保持固定：1 × A100 80GB、12 个 CPU 核心和 144GB RAM；骨干模型通过 vLLM（Kwon 等人，2023）本地提供服务。

paragraphs.en: To study which components of MLE harnesses matter, we run a series of systematic ablations that attribute performance to individual interventions. We identify four broad families of such interventions and study their effect. Each one isolates a class of intervention employed by contemporary harnesses, re-implemented inside a single codebase so that only the intervention varies. For each intervention, we instantiate the simplest faithful version of the published component rather than any one system’s variant, so that any effect is attributable to the class of intervention rather than to an implementation detail. End-to-end fidelity to specific published systems is deferred to Section 5 , where we run those systems as released.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究 MLE harnesses 的哪些组件具有实际意义，我们进行了一系列系统性的消融实验，将性能归因于各个独立的干预措施。 我们识别出此类干预措施的四大类，并研究了它们的效果。 每一类都隔离了当前 harnesses 所采用的一类干预措施，并将其重新实现到单一代码库中，从而确保只有该干预措施本身存在差异。 对于每一项干预措施，我们都采用已发布组件的最简单且功能等效的版本，而非某个特定系统的变体，这样任何效果都可以归因于该类干预措施，而非实现细节。 对特定已发布系统的端到端忠实性将在第 5 节中讨论，届时我们将以原始发布版本运行这些系统。

paragraphs.en: Across all intervention families studied in this work, the coding agent environment is the highest-leverage intervention an MLE system can employ. We show empirically that additional machinery provides no statistically significant advantage as the coding agent is given more autonomy. Furthermore, in Section 5 we argue that every common additional harness intervention can plausibly be dismissed as redundant given a coding agent environment, and further hypothesize that the problems such interventions are usually designed to solve become null under the common MLE benchmark setting with modern LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中考察的所有干预方案中，编码智能体环境是 MLE 系统能够采用的最具影响力的干预措施。 我们通过实证表明，随着编码智能体被赋予更多自主权，额外的机制并未带来任何具有统计学意义的优势。 此外，在第 5 节中，我们认为，在编码智能体环境下，所有常见的额外约束干预措施都可以合理地被视为冗余；我们进一步假设，在现代 LLM 所采用的通用 MLE 基准设定下，这些干预措施通常旨在解决的问题将不复存在。

sents.zh: 此外，在第 5 节中，我们认为，在编码智能体环境下，所有常见的额外约束干预措施都可以合理地被视为冗余；我们进一步假设，在现代 LLM 所采用的通用 MLE 基准设定下，这些干预措施通常旨在解决的问题将不复存在。

paragraphs.en: Many MLE systems call LLMs through a chat -like interface, where the LLM receives a single prompt and can only generate text, with no direct interaction with the execution environment. Building a successful MLE system from this primitive requires sophisticated machinery, often including dedicated draft/debug/improve agents, careful context management, retry loops, and hand-crafted data-crawler scripts that give the agent enough information about the data to solve the task. A coding agent environment, by contrast, exposes file manipulation and execution primitives directly to the LLM, making it possible to greatly simplify such harnesses. We measure the impact of the coding agent environment by directly comparing the effectiveness of both interfaces. We ablate two different iterations , which serve as atomic units of work:
paragraphs.zh: 许多 MLE 系统通过类聊天界面调用 LLM，其中 LLM 仅接收单个提示词并只能生成文本，无法与执行环境直接交互。 要基于这一基础构建成功的 MLE 系统，需要复杂的机制，通常包括专门的草稿/调试/改进智能体、精细的上下文管理、重试循环以及手工编写的数据抓取脚本，这些脚本为智能体提供足够的数据信息以完成任务。 相比之下，编码智能体环境将文件操作和执行基础功能直接暴露给 LLM，从而可以大幅简化此类辅助框架。 我们通过直接比较两种接口的有效性，来衡量编码智能体环境所带来的影响。 我们对两个不同的迭代版本进行了消融分析，它们各自作为工作的原子单元：

paragraphs.en: The LLM is called through a chat API with a single problem prompt. The agent is handed the task description and an overview of the data structure and file contents. It must produce a complete solution script as text in a single response. If the script fails to execute, the agent is queried again with the error stack trace for debugging.
paragraphs.zh: 通过聊天 API 调用 LLM，并传入单个问题提示。 智能体接收任务描述以及数据结构和文件内容的概述。 它必须在一个响应中以文本形式生成完整的解决方案脚本。 如果脚本执行失败，系统会再次向智能体询问错误堆栈跟踪以进行调试。

sents.en: The LLM is called through a chat API with a single problem prompt.
sents.zh: 通过聊天 API 调用 LLM，并传入单个问题提示。

sents.en: The agent is handed the task description and an overview of the data structure and file contents.
sents.zh: 智能体接收任务描述以及数据结构和文件内容的概述。

sents.en: It must produce a complete solution script as text in a single response.
sents.zh: 它必须在一个响应中以文本形式生成完整的解决方案脚本。

sents.en: If the script fails to execute, the agent is queried again with the error stack trace for debugging.

paragraphs.en: A single coding agent session is spawned. The agent starts in a working directory containing the data and is free to use filesystem and code-execution primitives to explore, write, execute and debug. In addition to the ML pipeline, the agent is tasked to document its solution in a markdown file.

paragraphs.en: Both iterations produce a single submission file within a six-hour time limit, and their prompts share a common template, deviating only in environment-specific instructions. The submission is later graded and the hidden test scores are never communicated back to the agents. Implementation details are given in Appendix B.1 .

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the impact of the coding agent environment on MLE tasks. We observe that the performance of frontier LLMs — GLM 5.2 and Kimi K3 — dramatically improves when they get direct access to the execution environment. Interestingly, even weaker models such as Gemma 4 benefit, suggesting that tool-use fluency matters more than raw model size in this setting. This is further supported by the larger improvement of the DeepSeek V4 models compared with their Preview versions. We study the effect of the time budget on Oneshot iterations in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了编码智能体环境对 MLE 任务的影响。 我们观察到，当前沿 LLM（GLM 5.2 和 Kimi K3）能够直接访问执行环境时，其性能得到了显著提升。 有趣的是，即使是像 Gemma 4 这样较弱的模型也能从中受益，这表明在这种设定下，工具使用的流畅性比模型本身的规模更为重要。 DeepSeek V4 模型相较于其 Preview 版本表现出的更大提升，进一步支持了这一结论。 我们在附录 C.1 中研究了时间预算对 Oneshot 迭代的影响。

paragraphs.en: MLE systems usually explore the solution space with tree or graph search over a set of ML pipelines. Previous work ( Toledo et al., 2025 ) has explored the impact of different search algorithms for chat-based AIDE-like systems and found that careful co-design of search policy and instructions improves performance. We test whether such findings extend to coding agent systems by chaining Oneshot iterations to refine their solutions at a matched 24h budget under different tree search algorithms (details in Appendix B.3 ):
paragraphs.zh: MLE 系统通常通过在一组机器学习管道上执行树搜索或图搜索来探索解空间。 先前的研究（Toledo 等人，2025）探讨了不同搜索算法对基于聊天的 AIDE 类系统的影响，并发现精心协同设计搜索策略和指令能够提升性能。 我们通过将 Oneshot 迭代串联起来，在不同树搜索算法下以匹配的 24 小时预算内优化其解决方案，来检验这些发现是否适用于编码智能体系统（详见附录 B.3）：

sents.en: MLE systems usually explore the solution space with tree or graph search over a set of ML pipelines.
sents.zh: MLE 系统通常通过在一组机器学习管道上执行树搜索或图搜索来探索解空间。

sents.en: Previous work ( Toledo et al., 2025 ) has explored the impact of different search algorithms for chat-based AIDE-like systems and found that careful co-design of search policy and instructions improves performance.
sents.zh: 先前的研究（Toledo 等人，2025）探讨了不同搜索算法对基于聊天的 AIDE 类系统的影响，并发现精心协同设计搜索策略和指令能够提升性能。

sents.en: We test whether such findings extend to coding agent systems by chaining Oneshot iterations to refine their solutions at a matched 24h budget under different tree search algorithms (details in Appendix B.3 ):
sents.zh: 我们通过将 Oneshot 迭代串联起来，在不同树搜索算法下以匹配的 24 小时预算内优化其解决方案，来检验这些发现是否适用于编码智能体系统（详见附录 B.3）：

paragraphs.en: always picks the most recent node as parent and represents pure iterative improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 总是选择最新的节点作为父节点，并代表纯粹的迭代改进。

paragraphs.en: picks the node with the best validation score as parent and represents pure exploitation.
paragraphs.zh: 选择验证分数最高的节点作为父节点，这代表纯粹的利用策略。

paragraphs.en: applies an upper-confidence-bound rule over visits and validation scores and represents the classical explore-exploit trade-off, using standard rank-normalized scores.
paragraphs.zh: 该规则在访问次数和验证分数上应用了上置信界法则，体现了经典的探索-利用权衡，并使用标准的秩归一化分数。

paragraphs.en: starts in an empty tree with no information from previous iterations and represents diverse, completely independent exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 它从一个空树开始，没有来自先前迭代的信息，并代表多样化且完全独立的探索。

paragraphs.en: Figure shows that the search strategy has a very small effect on performance, with largely overlapping CIs. Interestingly, Best-of-N starts strongly but slows down later on, which may indicate a ceiling beyond which refinement is needed to improve on certain tasks. In addition to per-method marginal CIs, we compare each pair of search methods using paired-by-task 95% CIs on their performance difference. Appendix A.5 describes our statistical protocol, and Appendix C.2 gives detailed results.
paragraphs.zh: 该图显示，搜索策略对性能的影响非常小，置信区间（CIs）基本重叠。 有趣的是，Best-of-N 初期表现强劲，但后期速度放缓，这可能表明存在一个上限，超过该上限后需要通过进一步优化来在某些任务上取得改进。 除了每种方法的边际置信区间外，我们还使用按任务配对的 95% 置信区间（CIs）比较每对搜索方法在性能差异上的表现。 附录 A.5 描述了我们的统计方案，附录 C.2 提供了详细结果。

sents.zh: 该图显示，搜索策略对性能的影响非常小，置信区间（CIs）基本重叠。

sents.en: Interestingly, Best-of-N starts strongly but slows down later on, which may indicate a ceiling beyond which refinement is needed to improve on certain tasks.

sents.en: Appendix A.5 describes our statistical protocol, and Appendix C.2 gives detailed results.
sents.zh: 附录 A.5 描述了我们的统计方案，附录 C.2 提供了详细结果。

paragraphs.en: Under the paired-by-task analysis, no strategy provides a statistically significant advantage in either percentile or medal rate. The pair with the largest gap is Best-of-N and UCB1, with UCB1 ahead by an average of 2.71 percentile points (pp), 95% CI ( − 1.44 , + 6.60 ) (-1.44,+6.60) . We conclude that, given documentation of previous solutions and tools that facilitate data and execution exploration, the agent can already weigh different approaches and implicitly adapt its search based on previous results, as we illustrate in Section 5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在按任务分组的分析中，没有任何一种策略在百分位或奖牌率方面表现出统计学上的显著优势。 差距最大的组合是“最佳-N”与UCB1，其中UCB1平均领先2.71个百分位点（pp），95%置信区间为（−1.44，+6.60）。 我们得出结论：鉴于已有对先前解决方案的文档记录以及有助于数据与执行探索的工具，该智能体已经能够权衡不同方法，并基于先前结果隐式地调整其搜索策略，正如我们在第5.2节中所展示的那样。

sents.zh: 在按任务分组的分析中，没有任何一种策略在百分位或奖牌率方面表现出统计学上的显著优势。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we note that Best-of-N’s self-selected performance falls 6.832pp short of its oracle (ceiling). This corresponds to the largest selection gap among all explored search strategies. Part of this gap comes from noise and is unavoidable ( Hambardzumyan et al., 2026 ) , but strategies to reduce it should be a priority when designing MLE harnesses. Appendix C.3 explores a few mitigation strategies in our controlled environment. We leave an in-depth exploration of more strategies for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们注意到，Best-of-N 的自选性能比其理想上限（天花板）低了 6.832pp。 这是所有已探索搜索策略中最大的选择差距。 这一差距的部分原因来自噪声且不可避免（Hambardzumyan 等，2026），但在设计 MLE 工具时，应优先采取减少该差距的策略。 附录 C.3 在我们的受控环境中探讨了几种缓解策略。 我们将更深入地探索更多策略的工作留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: In the previous ablations, the search is orchestrated manually by the harness. In this section, we remove such orchestration altogether and arrive at an even simpler baseline, which we label Malena. The Malena iteration is also built on the coding agent infrastructure but, instead of being prompted to produce a single submission, runs a single session spanning the entire time budget, only briefly prompted to continue working whenever a turn ends. This lets the agent drive exploration, exploitation and its own knowledge base autonomously. We build a minimal harness around it, providing a small set of tools that may help the agent stay grounded as the session grows: 1 1 1 We ablate the importance of such tools in Appendix C.6 , and provide further details of them in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在之前的消融实验中，搜索过程由框架手动协调。 在本节中，我们完全移除这种协调机制，从而得到一个更简单的基线模型，我们将其命名为 Malena。 Malena 迭代版本同样构建于编码智能体基础设施之上，但与要求生成单次提交不同，它会运行一个贯穿整个时间预算的单一会话，仅在每次回合结束时短暂提示其继续工作。 这使得智能体能够自主地驱动探索、利用以及自身的知识库建设。 我们在其周围构建了一个最小化的框架，提供一组小型工具，以帮助智能体在会话扩展时保持方向：1 1 1 我们在附录 C.6 中消融了这些工具的重要性，并在附录 B.2 中提供了更多相关细节。

sents.zh: 在之前的消融实验中，搜索过程由框架手动协调。

sents.en: This lets the agent drive exploration, exploitation and its own knowledge base autonomously.
sents.zh: 这使得智能体能够自主地驱动探索、利用以及自身的知识库建设。

sents.en: We build a minimal harness around it, providing a small set of tools that may help the agent stay grounded as the session grows: 1 1 1 We ablate the importance of such tools in Appendix C.6 , and provide further details of them in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: submission tool: Adds a submission file to the registry. No test or leaderboard scores are communicated to the agent. This tool is not needed in Chat and Oneshot iterations, whose single submission is added to the registry by the harness.

paragraphs.en: jobs tools: Allow the agent to run multiple bash commands in the background, inspect their stdout separately, wait for their completion, and cancel ongoing jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 作业工具：允许智能体在后台运行多个 bash 命令，分别检查其标准输出，等待其完成，并取消正在运行的作业。

paragraphs.en: As seen in Figure , the Malena iteration reaches the highest average medal rate. Paired-by-task analysis indicates a significant medal rate advantage over all manual search algorithms, with 95% CI lower bounds between 0.4% and 5.6% depending on the method. Despite having also better average percentile, when compared with UCB1 and Greedy it becomes statistically indistinguishable. Regardless, Malena exhibits the lowest validation gap of all iterations at 1.876pp, presumably as reusing the exact validation pipeline between attempts allows to maintain higher consistency between internal validation scores than tree-search methods. We further explore the effect of Malena under different time budgets in Appendix C.4 and the effect of backbone models in Appendix C.5 . One possible drawback of this single-session strategy arises in the long-horizon regime, where the context may overflow the LLM’s window. To test this, Appendix C.7 artificially caps Malena’s context window.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 所示，Malena 迭代达到了最高的平均奖牌率。 按任务配对的分析表明，与所有手动搜索算法相比，其奖牌率具有显著优势，95% 置信区间的下限因方法不同而在 0.4% 到 5.6% 之间。 尽管其平均百分位也更高，但与 UCB1 和 Greedy 相比，统计上已无法区分。 无论如何，Malena 在所有迭代中表现出最低的验证差距，为 1.876pp；这可能是因为每次尝试之间重复使用完全相同的验证流程，使得内部验证分数比树搜索方法更具一致性。 我们在附录 C.4 中进一步探讨了 Malena 在不同时间预算下的效果，并在附录 C.5 中探讨了骨干模型的影响。 这种单次会话策略的一个潜在缺点出现在长期场景中，此时上下文可能会超出 LLM 的窗口范围。 为了验证这一点，附录 C.7 人为地限制了 Malena 的上下文窗口。

paragraphs.en: MLE harnesses often guide exploration using several, potentially parallel, agents. Such agents are typically organized either hierarchically or as a network of peers. We attempt to isolate the effectiveness of such procedures by introducing three coordination interventions:
paragraphs.zh: MLE 框架通常通过多个可能并行的智能体来引导探索。 这类智能体通常以层级结构或同伴网络的形式组织。 我们通过引入三种协调干预措施，试图明确此类程序的有效性：

sents.en: MLE harnesses often guide exploration using several, potentially parallel, agents.
sents.zh: MLE 框架通常通过多个可能并行的智能体来引导探索。

sents.en: Such agents are typically organized either hierarchically or as a network of peers.
sents.zh: 这类智能体通常以层级结构或同伴网络的形式组织。

sents.en: We attempt to isolate the effectiveness of such procedures by introducing three coordination interventions:
sents.zh: 我们通过引入三种协调干预措施，试图明确此类程序的有效性：

paragraphs.en: Delegation. Enables background subagents via the native task tool and encourages their use through a prompt addition. This represents the hierarchical planner–executor structure.
paragraphs.zh: 委派。 通过原生任务工具启用后台子智能体，并通过添加提示词来鼓励使用它们。 这体现了分层规划器-执行器结构。

sents.en: Delegation.
sents.zh: 委派。

sents.en: Enables background subagents via the native task tool and encourages their use through a prompt addition.
sents.zh: 通过原生任务工具启用后台子智能体，并通过添加提示词来鼓励使用它们。

sents.en: This represents the hierarchical planner–executor structure.

paragraphs.en: Parallelism. When enabled, the harness spawns three independent Malena iterations on the same physical machine. While this allows more submissions and ideas to be tested, it also risks hardware contention. Parallelism represents the network of peers.
paragraphs.zh: 并行性。 启用后，该测试框架会在同一台物理机器上启动三个独立的 Malena 迭代。 虽然这样能测试更多的提交和创意，但也存在硬件资源竞争的风险。 并行性代表了同伴之间的网络。

sents.en: Parallelism.
sents.zh: 并行性。

sents.en: When enabled, the harness spawns three independent Malena iterations on the same physical machine.
sents.zh: 启用后，该测试框架会在同一台物理机器上启动三个独立的 Malena 迭代。

sents.en: While this allows more submissions and ideas to be tested, it also risks hardware contention.

sents.en: Parallelism represents the network of peers.
sents.zh: 并行性代表了同伴之间的网络。

paragraphs.en: broadcast tool. Enabled jointly with parallelism. Allows agents to broadcast messages to their peers; messages are queued and delivered to each recipient when its current turn ends.
paragraphs.zh: 广播工具。 与并行处理共同启用。 允许智能体向同伴广播消息；消息会被排队，并在每个接收者的当前回合结束时送达。

paragraphs.en: We present the results in Table 1 . The base Malena iteration performs no significantly worse than any intervention tested. While the parallel addition provides a higher ceiling in oracle-selected percentile score, the selection gap of independent Malena iterations increases under such setting so much that the final self-select submission is of similar quality. This suggests that the multi-agent orchestration introduced in previous work is less critical for modern frontier LLMs operating in coding agent environments. How to properly coordinate strong agents towards a common goal remains an open question, and we leave a deeper examination for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 1 中展示了结果。 基础 Malena 迭代的表现与任何经过测试的干预措施相比，都没有显著更差。 虽然并行加法在神谕选择的百分位分数上提供了更高的上限，但在这种设置下，独立 Malena 迭代的选取差距增大到如此程度，以至于最终的自我选择提交质量相当接近。 这表明，先前工作中引入的多智能体协调机制，对于在编码智能体环境中运行的现代前沿 LLM 而言，重要性较低。 如何恰当协调强大的智能体以实现共同目标仍然是一个开放问题，我们将更深入的研究留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: We test whether the conclusions of Section 4 generalize to a wider selection of open-source state-of-the-art harnesses. We compare our base Malena single long-session loop with MLEvolve ( Du et al., 2026 ) , AiScientist ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , Arbor ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , and ScienceFlow ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; full descriptions of each baseline, and the full per-backbone MLE-bench comparison table, are in Appendix D . The selected methods span a wide range of harness design choices along the axes we ablated. MLEvolve represents the older paradigm, in which the minimal unit of work is a single completion; the others are more recent and emphasize orchestrating multiple agentic sessions with tools. Malena itself is a single such session, so the comparison is not chat-vs-agent but rather a minimal single-session harness against harnesses that add scaffolding on top of agentic sessions or completions. Crucially, all methods are evaluated under the same compute resources, time budget and backbone models. 2 2 2 Every harness runs at its backbone’s maximum reasoning effort, except MLEvolve on DeepSeek V4 Flash, which runs at medium effort; see Appendix D.3 for details. In addition to MLE-bench, we report results on NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , a benchmark of open scientific-research tasks that is newer and less saturated by published baselines than MLE-bench; Appendix A.3 describes it in full.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验第 4 节的结论是否适用于更广泛的开源前沿智能体框架。 我们将 Malena 的基础单长会话循环与 MLEvolve（Du et al., 2026）、AiScientist（Chen et al., 2026a）、Arbor（Jin et al., 2026）和 ScienceFlow（Zhao et al., 2026）进行比较；每个基线方法的完整描述以及各主干模型对应的 MLE-bench 完整对比表见附录 D。 所选方法涵盖了我们在消融分析中涉及的各个维度上多种多样的框架设计选择。 MLEvolve 代表旧有范式，其最小工作单元为单次完成；其他方法则较新，强调通过工具协调多个智能体会话。 Malena 本身即属于此类单次会话，因此该比较并非“聊天 vs 智能体”，而是将最小单会话框架与在智能体会话或单次完成基础上增加支撑结构的框架进行比较。 关键在于，所有方法均在相同的计算资源、时间预算和主干模型下进行评估。2 2 2 除 MLEvolve 在 DeepSeek V4 Flash 上以中等推理强度运行外，所有框架均以对应主干模型的最大推理强度运行；详见附录 D.3。 除了 MLE-bench，我们还报告了 NatureBench（Wang et al., 2026b）上的结果；该基准包含开放的科学研究任务，相较于 MLE-bench 更新且已发表的基线方法更少；附录 A.3 对其进行了完整描述。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 , Figure 1 , and Figure 3 summarize the headline results: across 17 harness–backbone pairs on the 30 MLE-bench tasks and 6 pairs on the 40 NatureBench tasks (full specification in Appendix D ), Malena matches or beats every harness on every tested pair. Only at the smaller Gemma 4 31B backbone does the picture change, with MLEvolve ahead by mean estimate, though its medal rate confidence intervals still overlap Malena’s. A detailed paired-by-task comparison is in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 2、图 1 和图 3 总结了主要结果：在 30 个 MLE-bench 任务中的 17 对 harness–backbone 组合以及 40 个 NatureBench 任务中的 6 对组合上（完整说明见附录 D），Malena 在所有测试的组合中均与每个 harness 表现一致或更优。 仅在较小的 Gemma 4 31B backbone 上情况有所不同，MLEvolve 的平均估计值更高，但其奖牌率置信区间仍与 Malena 的置信区间存在重叠。 详细的按任务划分的配对比较见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: The left panel of Figure 3 shows all four methods following a broadly similar quality-vs-wall-clock-time profile: quality rises quickly in the first few hours, plateaus by around the 5–10 hour mark, and further gains afterwards arrive mostly as occasional step jumps — when a new best submission lands — rather than as smooth continued improvement. AiScientist generally lags behind, except in the final ≈ \approx 4 hours, where it quickly catches up, and MLEvolve is the slowest to plateau.
paragraphs.zh: 图3的左侧面板显示了所有四种方法大致相似的质量与真实时间之间的关系曲线：质量在前几小时内迅速上升，在大约5至10小时时进入平台期，此后的进一步提升主要表现为偶尔的阶梯式跃升——即当新的最佳提交结果出现时——而非持续平稳的改进。 AiScientist总体上表现滞后，但在最后约 \approx 4 小时中迅速追了上来；而MLEvolve则是最晚进入平台期的方法。

paragraphs.en: The right panel of Figure 3 shows the inference cost of each method. Although total token volumes are comparable across agentic harnesses, cost is driven almost entirely by cache-read tokens. At GLM 5.2, Malena’s modeled USD cost ($12.12) is ≈ \approx 6.2 × \times AiScientist’s ($1.95), even though its input and output token volumes are comparable to Arbor’s and AiScientist’s --- only its cache-read usage is roughly an order of magnitude higher. This follows directly from Malena running as a single ever-growing session that resends its whole prior context every turn (the same-session cache model still prices that resent context, even though it credits most of it as a cache hit); Arbor and AiScientist instead reset into fresh, shorter-lived threads per branch or submission, so their modeled cache-read volume never grows as large. Nonetheless, overall cost remains dominated by hardware. 3 3 3 For our hardware configuration, 24h of A100 80GB compute can total between $24 and $85, depending on the provider.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 的右侧面板展示了每种方法的推理成本。 尽管各智能体框架的总令牌量相当，但成本几乎完全由缓存读取令牌决定。 在 GLM 5.2 中，Malena 的模拟美元成本（$12.12）约为 AiScientist（$1.95）的 ≈ \approx 6.2 × \times 倍，尽管其输入和输出令牌量与 Arbor 及 AiScientist 相当——只有其缓存读取使用量大约高一个数量级。 这直接源于 Malena 以单个持续增长的会话运行，并在每一步重新发送其全部先前上下文（同一会话的缓存模型仍会对该重新发送的上下文计费，尽管其中大部分被计为缓存命中）；而 Arbor 和 AiScientist 则会在每个分支或提交中重置为新的、生命周期更短的线程，因此它们模拟的缓存读取量从未增长到如此之大。 尽管如此，总体成本仍然主要由硬件决定。3 3 3 对于我们的硬件配置，24 小时 A100 80GB 计算资源的总成本可能在 $24 到 $85 之间，具体取决于提供商。

paragraphs.en: We now examine whether Malena exhibits the failure mode that motivates prior designs, and how severely. The failure mode these designs are most explicitly built around is an inability to reliably search the space of ML solutions, so we focus our trace analysis on search, studying in depth the traces of Kimi K3 and GLM 5.2 under MLEvolve, AiScientist, Malena and Oneshot iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在要考察 Malena 是否表现出促使先前设计产生的故障模式，以及这种故障的严重程度。 这些设计最明确围绕构建的故障模式，是无法可靠地搜索机器学习解决方案的空间，因此我们将追踪分析集中在搜索上，深入研究 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.2 在 MLEvolve、AiScientist、Malena 和 Oneshot 迭代过程中的追踪数据。

sents.en: We now examine whether Malena exhibits the failure mode that motivates prior designs, and how severely.
sents.zh: 我们现在要考察 Malena 是否表现出促使先前设计产生的故障模式，以及这种故障的严重程度。

sents.en: The failure mode these designs are most explicitly built around is an inability to reliably search the space of ML solutions, so we focus our trace analysis on search, studying in depth the traces of Kimi K3 and GLM 5.2 under MLEvolve, AiScientist, Malena and Oneshot iterations.
sents.zh: 这些设计最明确围绕构建的故障模式，是无法可靠地搜索机器学习解决方案的空间，因此我们将追踪分析集中在搜索上，深入研究 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.2 在 MLEvolve、AiScientist、Malena 和 Oneshot 迭代过程中的追踪数据。

paragraphs.en: Prior designs typically impose an explicit search structure — a tree over candidate ideas (Arbor, MLEvolve), a population of competing programs, or a stagnation-triggered switch to a fresh idea (ScienceFlow) — built around a discrete unit of work or checkpoint that is either refined or abandoned. Malena’s workflow with GLM 5.2 and Kimi K3 differs qualitatively: it produces a single general pipeline spanning a task’s natural stages (e.g., the two-stage embed-then-retrieve pipeline on whale ; see Appendix E.5 ), then spends the rest of the run on what amounts to hyperparameter search, but over code patches rather than parameter values. This lets it reuse checkpoints and utility code (data loading, preprocessing, validation splits) across iterations, improving efficiency and narrowing the generalization gap.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的设计通常采用显式的搜索结构——例如候选想法构成的树（Arbor、MLEvolve）、相互竞争的程序种群，或在进展停滞时切换到新想法的机制（ScienceFlow）——这些结构都围绕着一个离散的工作单元或检查点构建，该单元要么被优化，要么被放弃。 Malena 使用 GLM 5.2 和 Kimi K3 的工作流程在性质上有所不同：它首先生成一个贯穿任务自然阶段的单一通用流程（例如，针对鲸鱼任务的“先嵌入、后检索”两阶段流程；参见附录 E.5），然后在运行剩余时间中执行相当于超参数搜索的操作，但搜索对象是代码片段而非参数值。 这使得它能够在不同迭代中重复使用检查点和辅助代码（如数据加载、预处理和验证集划分），从而提升效率并缩小泛化差距。

sents.en: Prior designs typically impose an explicit search structure — a tree over candidate ideas (Arbor, MLEvolve), a population of competing programs, or a stagnation-triggered switch to a fresh idea (ScienceFlow) — built around a discrete unit of work or checkpoint that is either refined or abandoned.
sents.zh: 早期的设计通常采用显式的搜索结构——例如候选想法构成的树（Arbor、MLEvolve）、相互竞争的程序种群，或在进展停滞时切换到新想法的机制（ScienceFlow）——这些结构都围绕着一个离散的工作单元或检查点构建，该单元要么被优化，要么被放弃。

sents.en: Malena’s workflow with GLM 5.2 and Kimi K3 differs qualitatively: it produces a single general pipeline spanning a task’s natural stages (e.g., the two-stage embed-then-retrieve pipeline on whale ; see Appendix E.5 ), then spends the rest of the run on what amounts to hyperparameter search, but over code patches rather than parameter values.
sents.zh: Malena 使用 GLM 5.2 和 Kimi K3 的工作流程在性质上有所不同：它首先生成一个贯穿任务自然阶段的单一通用流程（例如，针对鲸鱼任务的“先嵌入、后检索”两阶段流程；参见附录 E.5），然后在运行剩余时间中执行相当于超参数搜索的操作，但搜索对象是代码片段而非参数值。

sents.en: This lets it reuse checkpoints and utility code (data loading, preprocessing, validation splits) across iterations, improving efficiency and narrowing the generalization gap.
sents.zh: 这使得它能够在不同迭代中重复使用检查点和辅助代码（如数据加载、预处理和验证集划分），从而提升效率并缩小泛化差距。

paragraphs.en: Going further, we annotate each trajectory’s checkpoints with the ML techniques used (see Appendix E for the full labeling methodology) to see how each method searches and what it searches over. Two findings stand out. First, methods with LLM-driven search (Malena and AiScientist) start out balanced across the stages of a standard ML pipeline — data preprocessing, feature engineering, architecture, training, and beyond — with AiScientist slightly skewed towards model selection early on. Both become more performance-oriented towards the end of the run, concentrating on ensembling and, at times, techniques borrowed from the Kaggle community such as pseudo-labeling (Appendix E.5 gives a worked example of Malena independently rediscovering this technique under two different backbones). This late-run shift is more pronounced for Malena than for AiScientist, with the shares of ensembling, model selection, and post-processing all increasing until the very end of the run. MLEvolve, in contrast, settles into a roughly stable technique distribution after about the first 10% of the run (Figure 5 ). Second, this skew towards performance does not confine Malena to well-known recipes: Figure 4 shows that Malena and MLEvolve are consistently the top two methods in technique rarity (see Appendix E.2 for how rarity is computed), i.e., the techniques they use tend to appear in fewer of the other groups’ runs. Malena therefore keeps proposing comparatively rare techniques while becoming more performance-oriented late in the run.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步分析，我们为每条轨迹的检查点标注了所用到的机器学习技术（完整标注方法请参见附录 E），以便观察每种方法如何进行搜索以及搜索范围。其中有两项发现尤为突出。 首先，采用 LLM 驱动搜索的方法（Malena 和 AiScientist）在标准机器学习流程的各个阶段——数据预处理、特征工程、模型架构、训练及后续步骤——初期表现较为均衡，但 AiScientist 在早期略微偏向模型选择。 两种方法在运行后期都变得更加注重性能，集中于集成学习，有时还会采用来自 Kaggle 社区的技术，例如伪标签法（附录 E.5 提供了 Malena 在两种不同骨干网络下独立重新发现该技术的具体示例）。 这种运行后期的转向在 Malena 中比 AiScientist 更为明显：集成学习、模型选择和后处理的占比均持续增加，直至运行完全结束。 相比之下，MLEvolve 在运行开始后的前 10% 左右便达到了技术分布的大致稳定状态（图 5）。 其次，这种对性能的倾向并未使 Malena 局限于众所周知的方案：图 4 显示，Malena 和 MLEvolve 在技术稀有度方面始终位列前两名（稀有度的计算方式请参见附录 E.2），也就是说，它们所使用的技术在其他组的运行中出现的频率较低。 因此，Malena 在运行后期逐渐更注重性能的同时，仍然持续提出相对稀有的技术。

paragraphs.en: Together, these results suggest that a sufficiently capable coding-agent backbone can drive this kind of search largely on its own: Malena balances exploring genuinely rare techniques against a growing performance focus as the run progresses, all while efficiently reusing the checkpoints, utility code, and other artifacts it has already produced rather than starting over, with no hand-built harness needed to elicit this behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果共同表明，一个能力足够强的编码智能体主干系统可以在很大程度上独立驱动此类搜索：随着运行过程的推进，Malena 在探索真正罕见的技术方法与日益增长的性能需求之间取得了平衡，同时高效地复用其已生成的检查点、实用代码和其他产物，而无需从头开始，也无需任何人工构建的框架来引导这种行为。

paragraphs.en: Systems for autonomous machine learning engineering have grown steadily more elaborate: search trees over candidate solutions, populations of competing programs, teams of specialized agents. That machinery was designed when the underlying unit of work was a single model completion, which cannot run the code it writes, remember what it already tried, or react to an error. Coding-focused post-training has since changed the primitive itself: a model highly capable of autonomous work plans, executes and debugs inside one long-running session, without an outer program telling it what to do next. This paper asks which of the accumulated machinery still earns its keep once the primitive can do these things itself, and answers it by ablating that machinery layer by layer at a fixed model, budget and task set.
paragraphs.zh: 自主机器学习工程系统日益复杂：从候选解的搜索树、相互竞争的程序种群，到由专业智能体组成的团队。 当时设计这些机制时，其基础工作单元是单个模型实例，而该实例既无法运行自己编写的代码，也无法记住已尝试过的内容或应对错误。 此后，以编码为重点的后续训练改变了这一基础单元本身：一个模型能够高度自主地制定工作计划，并在一次长时间运行的会话中完成执行与调试，无需外部程序指示其下一步操作。 本文探讨了当基础单元自身已具备这些能力后，此前积累的各种机制中哪些仍有存在的必要，并通过在固定模型、预算和任务集下逐层移除这些机制来给出答案。

sents.en: This paper asks which of the accumulated machinery still earns its keep once the primitive can do these things itself, and answers it by ablating that machinery layer by layer at a fixed model, budget and task set.
sents.zh: 本文探讨了当基础单元自身已具备这些能力后，此前积累的各种机制中哪些仍有存在的必要，并通过在固定模型、预算和任务集下逐层移除这些机制来给出答案。

paragraphs.en: Almost all of the gain comes from the runtime and LLM backbone, and almost none from what is built on top of them. Giving the model a shell and a filesystem instead of a chat interface is the single largest effect we measure. Once that is in place, and as the coding agent is given more autonomy, the techniques accumulated by the test-time-compute literature over the last few years barely move the result. A model highly capable of autonomous work already does much of what these techniques were designed to supply from outside, so supplying it again buys little. A single long-running agent session with minimal machinery on top turns out to be a strong baseline, and none of the standard components we added improved on it.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎所有的增益都来自运行时间和 LLM 基础架构，而构建在它们之上的部分几乎没有任何贡献。 为模型提供一个外壳和文件系统，而不是聊天界面，是我们测得的单一最大影响。 一旦这一基础建立起来，并且随着编码智能体被赋予更多自主权，过去几年测试时计算文献中积累的技术几乎无法改变结果。 一个高度具备自主工作能力的模型已经完成了这些技术原本设计用来从外部提供的许多功能，因此再次提供这些功能几乎没有任何收益。 事实证明，一个仅包含最少上层机制的长期运行的智能体会话是一个强大的基准，而我们添加的任何标准组件都无法超越它。

paragraphs.en: We then confirm the same picture from the outside, against state-of-the-art systems built specifically for this task. Holding the model, hardware, and budget fixed, none of the published harnesses we tested significantly outperforms the plain agent session with frontier backbones. With GLM 5.2, Malena earns a medal on 62.5% of the competitions, compared with 47.1% for the best external harness tested. Across all backbones, our statistical analysis either favours Malena over the other harnesses or finds no significant medal-rate difference between them.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们从外部对同一图像进行了验证，并将其与专为该任务构建的顶尖系统进行了对比。 在模型、硬件和预算均固定的情况下，我们测试的所有已发布框架均未显著优于使用前沿基础模型的普通智能体会话。 使用 GLM 5.2 时，Malena 在 62.5% 的竞赛中获得了奖牌，而测试中表现最佳的外部框架仅为 47.1%。 在所有基础模型中，我们的统计分析要么显示 Malena 优于其他框架，要么发现它们之间的奖牌率没有显著差异。

sents.zh: 接着，我们从外部对同一图像进行了验证，并将其与专为该任务构建的顶尖系统进行了对比。

paragraphs.en: The practical reading is that effort spent elaborating harnesses around a model that is already strong at working autonomously has poor returns. The leverage is in the model and in the runtime it is given, not in the scaffolding built around them.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上的情况是，在围绕一个已经具备强大自主能力的模型构建复杂框架上所投入的努力，回报甚微。 真正的关键在于模型本身及其运行时间，而非围绕它们搭建的辅助结构。

sents.zh: 真正的关键在于模型本身及其运行时间，而非围绕它们搭建的辅助结构。

paragraphs.en: Most of our results rely on MLE-bench, which has known task-preparation issues and, being built from public Kaggle competitions, is a plausible contamination target; we mitigate this by fixing broken tasks, directly checking for contamination, and additionally evaluating on NatureBench. A second limitation is statistical power: some results still have confidence intervals wide enough to preclude strong claims about effect size, though we believe the weaker no-worse-than claims are well supported. A third is scope: most harness interventions we test operate within a single worker, and we leave a more in-depth exploration of sophisticated inter-agent coordination protocols to future work. A fourth is possible asymmetry in tuning effort between Malena and the external harnesses it is compared against; Appendix D.3 documents the backbone-specific bug fixes and configuration ablations we applied to each external harness to mitigate this. Full discussion in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的多数结果都依赖于 MLE-bench，但该数据集已知存在任务准备问题，并且由于它基于公开的 Kaggle 竞赛构建，因此很可能成为污染的目标；我们通过修复有问题的任务、直接检查是否存在污染，以及在 NatureBench 上进行额外评估来缓解这一问题。 第二个局限性是统计功效：部分结果的置信区间仍然足够宽，无法对效应量做出强有力的结论，但我们认为那些“效果不差于”的较弱结论得到了充分支持。 第三个局限性是研究范围：我们测试的大多数 harness 干预措施都在单个 worker 内部运行，而更深入的复杂智能体间协作协议的探索则留待未来工作完成。 第四个局限性是 Malena 与其对比的外部 harness 在调优努力上可能存在的不对称性；附录 D.3 记录了我们为每个外部 harness 应用的特定于 backbone 的 bug 修复和配置消融，以缓解这一问题。 完整讨论见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: Full experimental settings are described in Section 3 and in Appendix B : the coding agent framework and tool set exposed to the model in each iteration (Appendix B.2 ), the search strategies compared (Appendix B.3 ), and the exact LLM backbones and hosting configuration used, with their HuggingFace identifiers (Appendix A.4 ). The task sets used for both benchmarks are listed in full in Appendix A.1 (MLE-bench, including which tasks we fixed to remove data or ground-truth-leakage issues, and why) and Appendix A.3 (NatureBench); the exact code diffs we applied to fix the affected MLE-bench preparation scripts are given in Appendix A.2 . Our statistical methodology — how macro-task averages, bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired-by-task comparisons are computed — is described in Appendix A.5 .

paragraphs.en: Our primary dataset used in this paper is MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , which consists of 75 tasks. In this paper we focus on a subset of 30 tasks. We largely follow Hambardzumyan et al. (2026) , which used the 30 tasks reported in the GPT-5 system card ( Singh et al., 2026 ) for their experiments. We, however, substitute the task bms-molecular-translation in favor of alaska2-image-steganalysis , due to its more permissive license. Our final split consists of 5 Lite, 21 Medium and 4 High tasks. All tasks used in the paper are shown in Table 3 , along with the split they belong to and the shorthand name by which they may be referenced in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 本文使用的主要数据集是 MLE-bench（Chan 等人，2025），该数据集包含 75 个任务。在本文中，我们重点关注其中的 30 个任务子集。我们基本遵循 Hambardzumyan 等人（2026）的做法，他们在实验中使用了 GPT-5 系统卡（Singh 等人，2026）中报告的这 30 个任务。不过，由于 alaska2-image-steganalysis 的许可协议更为宽松，我们用它替代了任务 bms-molecular-translation。我们最终的划分包括 5 个 Lite 级、21 个 Medium 级和 4 个 High 级任务。本文中使用的所有任务均列于表 3 中，表中还标明了它们所属的划分类别以及本文中的简称。

paragraphs.en: Results presented in Section 4 are reported on the original MLE-bench without any intervention, and in the 29 task split (without either bms or alaska2 ). This split is referred to in this work as the default29 task split.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 节中呈现的结果是在未经任何干预的原始 MLE-bench 以及 29 项任务划分（不包含 bms 或 alaska2）上报告的。 在本研究中，该划分被称为默认 29 项任务划分。

paragraphs.en: We note that a subset of our tasks has been previously reported containing issues in the MLE-bench preparation scripts. Such issues may include missing data needed to correctly train ML pipelines, data present that leaks the ground truth predictions, etc. We have identified four competitions that could either lead to impossible tasks or are susceptible to cheating. In order to maintain a fair comparison set between our baselines and other tested public harnesses, we fixed such issues and report their performance for all results in this paper when comparing against existing baselines. Such tasks are marked with ‡ in Table 3 and the split is labeled as the fixed30 set in this paper. Appendix A.2 lists the exact code diffs applied to the MLE-bench preparation scripts, together with the underlying bugs they address.
paragraphs.zh: 我们注意到，我们任务中的部分任务此前已有报告指出，其 MLE-bench 准备脚本中存在一些问题。 这些问题可能包括缺少正确训练机器学习流程所需的数据、存在泄露真实预测结果的数据等。 我们已经识别出四个竞赛，这些竞赛要么可能导致任务无法完成，要么容易受到作弊行为的影响。 为了在基线模型与其他已测试的公开工具之间保持公平的比较基准，我们修复了这些问题，并在本文所有与现有基线模型比较的结果中报告了它们的性能。 此类任务在表 3 中以 ‡ 标记，且在本论文中该划分被标注为 fixed30 数据集。 附录 A.2 列出了对 MLE-bench 准备脚本所应用的具体代码差异，以及这些差异所解决的根本性错误。

paragraphs.en: Below we list the fixes for champs , hubmap , smartphone , and multi-modal : the bug in each, and the change we made to its MLE-bench prepare.py . All four issues are documented by the MLE-bench maintainers on GitHub, in the “Known Issues” section of the official repository’s README ( https://github.com/openai/mle-bench#known-issues ): champs in pull request #70 ( https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/pull/70 ), multi-modal in issue #77 ( https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/issues/77 ), smartphone in issue #93 ( https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/issues/93 ), and hubmap directly in the README. The maintainers deferred fixing them to avoid invalidating existing leaderboard submissions, so the upstream preparation scripts still contain these bugs; the diffs below are our own fixes. The diffs are shortened for space ( ... marks omitted context, comments are trimmed, and long lines are re-wrapped). In all four cases the train/test splits and private answers are identical to the original MLE-bench preparation; only the files given to the agent change.

paragraphs.en: NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) asks an agent to try to match or exceed the published state-of-the-art result of a recent Nature-family paper on that paper’s own held-out evaluation protocol. Unlike fixed30 ’s Kaggle competitions, there is no external leaderboard to compute a percentile against: each task ships a dedicated evaluation service that the agent may query online, unlimited times, via an /evaluate endpoint that returns the candidate’s score. We follow NatureBench’s own protocol and report a task as surpassed when its normalized gain score g > 0.1 g>0.1 . We report the beat-SOTA rate — the fraction of tasks on which the best score achieved anywhere in the run (oracle) surpasses the published SOTA — macro-averaged over a licensed task cohort at an 8h time budget, for both a GLM 5.2 and a Kimi K3 backbone.

paragraphs.en: In the task description, the Oneshot and Malena iterations are handed only the data paths (raw data directory, description file and sample submission file) since they can explore the data themselves through their tools. On the other hand, Chat receives the task description verbatim and an inline overview of the data computed by the harness: a directory tree of the data folder, per-file previews (per-column statistics for CSVs — dtype, cardinality/value counts, mean, range and NaN counts — auto-generated schemas for JSON files, and the first lines of text files, subject to a global character budget), and the first rows of the sample submission. All iterations execute inside a git worktree checked out at their parent node’s commit, and each produces a node whose recorded validation score tuple is what the search rules of Section 4.2 (Appendix B.3 ) consume.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务描述中，Oneshot 和 Malena 迭代仅被提供数据路径（原始数据目录、描述文件和示例提交文件），因为它们可以通过自己的工具自行探索数据。 另一方面，Chat 会原样接收任务描述，以及由测试框架计算出的数据内联概览：数据文件夹的目录树、每个文件的预览信息（CSV 文件的每列统计量——数据类型、基数/值计数、均值、范围及 NaN 计数；JSON 文件自动生成的模式；文本文件的前几行，受全局字符限制约束），以及示例提交的第一行内容。 所有迭代都在一个 git 工作树中执行，该工作树已检出至其父节点的提交版本，且每个迭代都会生成一个节点，其记录的验证得分元组正是第 4.2 节（附录 B.3）中的搜索规则所使用的内容。

The model receives the base prompt with the inline data overview and is instructed to reply with a complete, self-contained Python script that implements the full pipeline (data → \to model → \to training → \to inference) and writes submission.csv . paragraphs.en: If the run succeeds and the submission validates against the expected format, the agent is queried again with the output of the command to extract the validation score, and the iteration ends. Otherwise the harness re-prompts the model — appending to the same conversation — with a failure report containing the failure reason (non-zero exit, missing or invalid submission), the truncated stdout/stderr, a hardware-utilization summary, and a footer that disambiguates system kills (GPU-memory watchdog, RAM watchdog) from ordinary crashes. The model must answer with the full corrected script. This loop repeats until a valid submission is produced.
paragraphs.zh: 如果运行成功且提交内容符合预期格式，系统会再次向智能体查询命令的输出结果以提取验证分数，然后该迭代结束。 否则，测试框架会向模型重新发出提示——在相同的对话中追加信息——并提供一份失败报告，其中包含失败原因（非零退出码、提交内容缺失或无效）、截断的 stdout/stderr、硬件使用摘要，以及一个脚注以区分系统强制终止（GPU 内存看门狗、RAM 看门狗）与普通崩溃。 模型必须返回完整的修正后脚本作为回答。 此循环将持续重复，直到生成有效的提交内容为止。

paragraphs.en: Oneshot . One coding-agent session, one conversation turn, under the default tool environment of Appendix B.2 . The prompt instructs the agent to treat the worktree as a scratch directory to confirm its design with cheap verification runs (fast data-inspection scripts, then minimal test runs ), and to converge to exactly one production run . After one production run succeeds, no further heavy training is permitted, and failures may only be diagnosed with cheap runs, never with a second production attempt.
paragraphs.zh: 单次尝试。 一次编码智能体会话，一个对话回合，在附录 B.2 的默认工具环境中进行。 提示词要求智能体将工作树视为临时目录，通过低成本验证运行（快速的数据检查脚本，然后是最小测试运行）来确认其设计，并最终收敛到恰好一次生产运行。 一次生产运行成功后，不允许进行任何进一步的深度训练；若失败，则只能通过低成本运行进行诊断，绝不允许进行第二次生产尝试。

paragraphs.en: Four deliverables are required: main.py (the pipeline), submission.csv , design.md (a self-contained write-up of the design, results and rationale, meant to serve as the node’s documentation for later iterations), and score.txt (a single floating-point validation score on the task’s metric and direction). These deliverables are expressed as guarantees : when the agent ends its turn, the harness statically verifies the file set and re-prompts the agent with the list of missing or malformed guarantees (e.g. an unparsable score file) until all hold.
paragraphs.zh: 需要提交四项成果：main.py（流程代码）、submission.csv、design.md（一份独立完整的设计文档，包含设计思路、结果和依据，用作该节点在后续迭代中的文档），以及 score.txt（一个基于任务指标和方向的单浮点验证分数）。 这些成果以保障条款的形式提出：当智能体结束其回合时，系统会静态验证文件集合，并针对缺失或格式错误的保障条款（例如无法解析的分数文件）向智能体重新提示，直到所有条款均满足为止。

paragraphs.en: When the parent node already carries a scripted solution (a previous main.py and design.md ), the prompt switches to an improve variant: the agent is instructed to study the documented design, to decide between refining and pivoting using the recorded execution cost and results, and to overwrite the same files (any other scripts are discarded). This is the mechanism by which the search strategies of Section 4.2 share information between nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 当父节点已经包含一个脚本化解决方案（即之前的 main.py 和 design.md）时，提示会切换到改进版本：智能体被要求研究已记录的设计方案，根据记录的执行成本和结果决定是进行优化还是转向新方案，并覆盖相同的文件（任何其他脚本都会被丢弃）。 这就是第 4.2 节中搜索策略在节点之间共享信息的机制。

paragraphs.en: Malena . The same coding-agent environment as Oneshot, but the session is allowed to span the iteration’s entire time budget in place of a single production run, and the one-production-run and documentation requirements are lifted. The instructions grant the agent freedom to design any number of pipelines and produce any number of submissions, dividing its budget as it sees fit. The harness drives the session as a turn loop: whenever the agent ends a turn before the budget expires, it is re-prompted with a short follow-up message that reports the remaining time.
paragraphs.zh: 马莱娜。 与 Oneshot 使用相同的编码智能体环境，但会话可以贯穿整个迭代的时间预算，而不再局限于单次生产运行；同时取消单次生产运行和文档编写的相关要求。 该说明赋予智能体自由设计任意数量流程、生成任意数量提交结果的权利，并可根据自身判断分配时间预算。 执行框架将会话以回合循环的方式推进：每当智能体在预算耗尽前结束一个回合时，系统会再次提示其一条简短的后续消息，告知剩余时间。

paragraphs.en: Submissions are generally tracked using the submission plugin. The agent calls submissions_register itself (optionally consulting submissions_list ), reporting each submission together with its validation score and free-form metadata, with the prompt making explicit that only registered submissions count and that each registration is atomic and immediate. When the submission plugin is disabled, the agent simply saves submission files under a submissions/ directory and the harness salvages and registers every file found there at wrap-up (without a validation score). Unless explicitly stated, all experiments reported use the submission plugin with validation score signals.
paragraphs.zh: 提交通常通过提交插件进行追踪。 智能体自身调用 submissions_register（可选地参考 submissions_list），报告每次提交及其验证分数和自由格式元数据，提示中明确说明只有已注册的提交才有效，且每次注册都是原子性的并立即生效。 当提交插件被禁用时，智能体只需将提交文件保存到一个 submissions/ 目录中，测试框架会在结束时收集并注册该目录下的所有文件（但没有验证分数）。 除非另有明确说明，所有报告中的实验均使用带有验证分数信号的提交插件。

paragraphs.en: The discussion in this section only applies to coding agent iterations (Oneshot and Malena).

paragraphs.en: Our core coding agent loop harnesses over OpenCode. It preserves all default tools, except we explicitly disabled doom_loop , plan_exit , and question . Moreover, we overwrite the native bash tool with our own implementation (more information in the following overview). The most important and used tools for the coding agent are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心编码智能体循环基于 OpenCode 构建。 它保留了所有默认工具，但我们明确禁用了 doom_loop、plan_exit 和 question。 此外，我们用自己实现的版本覆盖了原生的 bash 工具（更多详情请见下文概述）。 编码智能体最重要且最常用的工具有：

sents.en: Our core coding agent loop harnesses over OpenCode.
sents.zh: 我们的核心编码智能体循环基于 OpenCode 构建。

sents.en: It preserves all default tools, except we explicitly disabled doom_loop , plan_exit , and question .
sents.zh: 它保留了所有默认工具，但我们明确禁用了 doom_loop、plan_exit 和 question。

sents.en: Moreover, we overwrite the native bash tool with our own implementation (more information in the following overview).
sents.zh: 此外，我们用自己实现的版本覆盖了原生的 bash 工具（更多详情请见下文概述）。

sents.en: The most important and used tools for the coding agent are:
sents.zh: 编码智能体最重要且最常用的工具有：

paragraphs.en: bash : Executes a command. Note that we disabled the native bash implementation, and used our own version. Both versions remain highly similar in usage, description and output format, except for the fact that we manually control the maximum command execution timeout (set to 24h in all experiments unless otherwise stated), general resource statistics are shown along with the output of the command upon completion (command duration and average and max CPU, GPU, RAM and VRAM usage by the command), along with a background watchdog service that automatically kills running commands shortly before the system runs out of memory, to avoid hard pod ejection by our compute provider. We only allow our agent to execute commands from a short whitelist, including pwd , ls* , python* , nvidia-smi and more.
paragraphs.zh: bash：执行一条命令。 请注意，我们禁用了原生 bash 实现，并使用了我们自己开发的版本。 两个版本在用法、描述和输出格式上高度相似，唯一的区别在于我们手动控制了命令执行的最大超时时间（除非另有说明，所有实验中均设为 24 小时），命令执行完成后会同时显示通用资源统计信息（命令执行时长以及 CPU、GPU、RAM 和 VRAM 的平均与最大使用量），此外还有一个后台看门狗服务，在系统内存即将耗尽前自动终止正在运行的命令，以避免计算服务提供商强制驱逐 pod。 我们仅允许智能体执行来自一份简短白名单的命令，包括 pwd、ls*、python*、nvidia-smi 等。

paragraphs.en: submission_register tool: Adds a submission file to the registry. No test or leaderboard scores are communicated to the agent. Additionally, the agent may use submission_list to list the previous submissions it has produced during the session. Whenever this tool is enabled, we also add a short text in the session’s prompt to guide the agent regarding its usage.
paragraphs.zh: submission_register 工具：将提交文件添加到注册表中。 不会向智能体传递任何测试或排行榜分数。 此外，智能体还可以使用 submission_list 列出其在本会话期间生成的先前提交内容。 每当启用此工具时，我们还会在会话提示中添加一段简短文本，以指导智能体如何使用该工具。

paragraphs.en: system tool: Returns the current hardware resources, utilization, and time remaining.
paragraphs.zh: 系统工具：返回当前的硬件资源、使用率以及剩余时间。

paragraphs.en: jobs tools: Allow running bash commands in the background, waiting for them to complete and cancelling ongoing jobs. Whenever this tool is enabled, we also set a maximum time limit of 10m to all bash calls to encourage its usage, and add a short usage guide in the session’s prompt about how to use it. This suite is composed of the following tools. job_submit : non-blocking, executes a command in the background and returns its general information (job ID, stdout path, etc.), job_wait : waits for a job to finish or, if specified, until a certain amount of time passes, job_queue : lists the running jobs, and job_info : a more detailed view of a particular job, including hardware usage, stdout location, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 作业工具：允许在后台运行 bash 命令，等待其完成并取消正在运行的作业。 每当启用此工具时，我们还会为所有 bash 调用设置 10 分钟的最大时间限制以鼓励使用它，并在会话提示中添加一份简短的使用指南，说明如何操作该工具。 该工具包由以下工具组成：job_submit：非阻塞式工具，在后台执行命令并返回其基本信息（作业 ID、stdout 路径等）；job_wait：等待某个作业完成，或根据指定条件等待一定时间；job_queue：列出正在运行的作业；以及 job_info：提供特定作业的更详细信息，包括硬件使用情况、stdout 位置等。

sents.en: jobs tools: Allow running bash commands in the background, waiting for them to complete and cancelling ongoing jobs.
sents.zh: 作业工具：允许在后台运行 bash 命令，等待其完成并取消正在运行的作业。

sents.en: Whenever this tool is enabled, we also set a maximum time limit of 10m to all bash calls to encourage its usage, and add a short usage guide in the session’s prompt about how to use it.

sents.en: This suite is composed of the following tools. job_submit : non-blocking, executes a command in the background and returns its general information (job ID, stdout path, etc.), job_wait : waits for a job to finish or, if specified, until a certain amount of time passes, job_queue : lists the running jobs, and job_info : a more detailed view of a particular job, including hardware usage, stdout location, and more.
sents.zh: 该工具包由以下工具组成：job_submit：非阻塞式工具，在后台执行命令并返回其基本信息（作业 ID、stdout 路径等）；job_wait：等待某个作业完成，或根据指定条件等待一定时间；job_queue：列出正在运行的作业；以及 job_info：提供特定作业的更详细信息，包括硬件使用情况、stdout 位置等。

paragraphs.en: skill : Loads a skill matching the input’s identifier. The agent is given the name and a one-line description of each available skill up front, and only loads the full body of a skill (via this tool) when it decides to consult it. We equip the agent with eight skills encoding common ML engineering strategies for iterating on a competition: submission-blueprint (build and verify the end-to-end submission pipeline first, using a trivial predictor, before training a real model); quick-strong-baseline (get the highest score for the least training and implementation effort, leaning on pretrained models and off-the-shelf libraries); cost-saving-techniques (a toolbox of levers — frozen backbones, low resolution, few epochs, data subsampling — for getting a faithful signal cheaply, meant to be folded into the other skills); simplification-probe (shrink the task, either by holding one axis at full difficulty while collapsing the rest, or by reformulating it as a smaller proxy task, to isolate where a score gap comes from); ablation-probe (design a controlled comparison that isolates one component’s contribution, holding everything else fixed); runtime-estimate (measure a few scaled-down configurations and extrapolate wall-clock and memory cost before committing to a full-scale run); stagnation-pivot (detect when recent attempts within the same paradigm have stopped improving and force the next attempt to pivot the model, loss, input representation, or problem decomposition rather than tweak a hyperparameter); and cross-iteration-synthesis (step back and read across several past attempts together to compose ideas, extract best practices, standardize the validation protocol, or resolve contradictions).
paragraphs.zh: skill：加载与输入标识符匹配的技能。 智能体在开始时会获得每个可用技能的名字和一行描述，只有在决定调用该技能时，才会通过此工具加载其完整内容。 我们为智能体配备了八项技能，这些技能编码了竞赛迭代中常用的机器学习工程策略：提交蓝图（首先使用一个简单的预测器构建并验证端到端的提交流程，然后再训练真实模型）；快速强基线（以最小的训练和实施努力获得最高分数，依赖预训练模型和现成库）；成本节约技术（一系列可用工具——冻结主干网络、低分辨率、少量训练轮次、数据子采样——用于低成本地获取可靠的信号，并计划整合到其他技能中）；简化探针（通过保持一个维度在完全难度水平而其他维度简化，或将其重新表述为更小的代理任务来缩小问题规模，从而定位分数差异的来源）；消融探针（设计受控比较以孤立某个组件的贡献，同时保持其他一切不变）；运行时估算（测量几个缩放的配置，并在执行全规模运行前外推实际运行时间和内存成本）；停滞转向（检测当同一范式内的近期尝试停止改进时，强制下一次尝试转向模型、损失函数、输入表示或问题分解，而非仅仅调整超参数）；以及跨迭代合成（后退一步，综合回顾过去多次尝试，以整合思路、提取最佳实践、标准化验证协议或解决矛盾之处）。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we also ablate the following set of wider interventions, that each may include prompt changes or other environment differences for the agent:
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们还对以下一系列更广泛的干预措施进行了消融研究，其中每一项都可能包含提示词的变化或智能体所面临的其他环境差异：

paragraphs.en: Delegation encouragement. This intervention enables background subagents via the native task tool, and encourages their use via a prompt addition.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓励委派任务。 该干预措施通过原生任务工具为后台子智能体提供支持，并通过添加提示词来鼓励其使用。

paragraphs.en: Time nudges: Scheduled at 25%, 50%, 75% and 90%, the system automatically queues a brief message to the session and informs the agent about elapsed time.
paragraphs.zh: 时间提示：系统会在 25%、50%、75% 和 90% 的时间节点安排提示，自动向会话发送一条简短消息，并通知智能体已过去的时间。

paragraphs.en: Resource nudge: Whenever the CPU or GPU utilization falls under 50%, the system queues a brief message to the agent to encourage more efficient use of resources. There is a 5 minute waiting time between nudges to avoid overcrowding the session with messages.
paragraphs.zh: 资源提示：每当 CPU 或 GPU 的使用率低于 50% 时，系统都会向智能体发送一条简短消息，以鼓励其更高效地利用资源。 每次提示之间会间隔 5 分钟，以免会话中被消息过度填充。

paragraphs.en: Strict validation guidelines: We inject to the prompt a set of strict validation guidelines the agent must adhere to, with the hopes to minimize data leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 严格的验证指南：我们会在提示中注入一套智能体必须遵循的严格验证指南，以期最大限度地减少数据泄露。

paragraphs.en: Minimal prompt: The initial prompt of the agent is simplified to contain only the crucial information, removing general guidelines to follow and examples.
paragraphs.zh: 最小提示：智能体的初始提示被简化为仅包含关键信息，移除了需要遵循的一般性指导方针和示例。

paragraphs.en: In the entire paper, unless otherwise specified, Oneshot iteration is evaluated without any intervention, and Malena makes use of the submission , system and jobs tools only.
paragraphs.zh: 在整篇论文中，除非另有说明，Oneshot 迭代均在不进行任何干预的情况下进行评估，且 Malena 仅使用提交、系统和作业工具。

paragraphs.en: The Chain and Greedy strategies are straightforward and are implemented as described in Section 4.2 . The UCB1 strategy follows a deterministic selection rule, applying the UCB1 index ( Auer et al., 2002 ) to the pool of existing nodes. Unlike the tree-descent formulation of UCT ( Kocsis & Szepesvári, 2006 ) adopted by prior MLE systems ( Du et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) , which recursively selects among the children of the current node, we score every node in the tree and take a single global supremum.
paragraphs.zh: Chain 和 Greedy 策略都很直接，其实现方式如第 4.2 节所述。 UCB1 策略遵循一种确定性选择规则，将 UCB1 指数（Auer 等，2002）应用于现有节点池。 与先前 MLE 系统（Du 等，2026；Chen 等，2026b）采用的 UCT 树下降形式（Kocsis & Szepesvári，2006）不同——该形式会递归地在当前节点的子节点中进行选择——我们对树中的每个节点进行评分，并取一个全局最大值。

paragraphs.en: Ranking rather than using the raw metric is what makes a single c c transferable across competitions: MLE-bench metrics are arbitrarily scaled and of mixed direction, and a rank transform is invariant to any order-preserving reparameterization of the metric while remaining robust to outlying runs, in the manner of the rank-based fitness shaping used by evolution strategies ( Hansen & Ostermeier, 2001 ; Wierstra et al., 2014 ) . Prior MLE harnesses instead min-max normalize the metric ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , substitute a bounded hand-designed reward ( Du et al., 2026 ) , or leave the metric raw and retune the exploration constant per setting ( Toledo et al., 2025 ) . Keeping the first term in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] also lets us adopt the exploration constant that the UCT analysis prescribes for bounded rewards, c ≈ 1 / 2 c\approx 1/\sqrt{2} , without per-task tuning ( Kocsis & Szepesvári, 2006 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 采用排名而非直接使用原始指标，正是这一做法使得单个 c 能够在不同竞赛中通用：MLE-bench 指标的尺度是任意设定的且方向混杂，而排名转换对任何保持指标顺序的重参数化都是不变的，同时仍能抵御异常运行结果的影响，其方式类似于演化策略中所使用的基于排名的适应度塑造（Hansen & Ostermeier, 2001；Wierstra et al., 2014）。 早期的 MLE 方法则采用最小-最大归一化来调整指标（Chen et al., 2026b），或用有界的人工设计奖励替代（Du et al., 2026），或者保留原始指标并根据不同设置重新调整探索常数（Toledo et al., 2025）。 将第一项保持在 [0, 1] 范围内，也使我们能够采用 UCT 分析为有界奖励所规定的探索常数 c ≈ 1 / √2，而无需针对每个任务单独调整（Kocsis & Szepesvári, 2006）。

paragraphs.en: Our strategy for Best-of-N methods consists of running independent single Oneshot iterations, and then composing a set of bootstrapped-trajectories B j = { T 1 j , … , T N j } B_{j}=\{T_{1}^{j},\ldots,T_{N}^{j}\} where each T i j T_{i}^{j} is a composition of multiple independent Oneshot iterations of the requested time limit budget. Each trajectory is packed greedily so that the summed effective time of its iterations does not exceed the target budget, and an iteration that would overflow the trajectory is discarded rather than carried into the next one. The budget is therefore matched on the time the iterations actually consume, not on their nominal per-iteration time limit. We can then extract all metrics for each trajectory T i j T_{i}^{j} by concatenating the submissions of all iterations in the trajectory. Finally, we sample multiple independent bootstrapped-trajectory sets B 1 , … , B M B_{1},\ldots,B_{M} and report the average-of-averages across this set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的最佳-N方法策略包括运行独立的单次Oneshot迭代，然后组合出一组自举轨迹 B j = { T 1 j , … , T N j } B_{j}=\{T_{1}^{j},\ldots,T_{N}^{j}\}，其中每个 T i j T_{i}^{j} 都是由请求的时间限制预算内多次独立的Oneshot迭代组合而成。 每条轨迹都采用贪心方式打包，以确保其迭代的有效时间总和不超过目标预算；任何可能导致轨迹超时的迭代都会被丢弃，而不是延续到下一条轨迹中。 因此，预算的匹配是基于迭代实际消耗的时间，而非其名义上的每次迭代时间限制。 随后，我们可以通过将轨迹 T i j T_{i}^{j} 中所有迭代的提交结果拼接起来，提取出每条轨迹的所有指标。 最后，我们采样多个独立的自举轨迹集合 B 1 , … , B M B_{1},\ldots,B_{M}，并报告该集合中各结果的平均值的平均值。

sents.en: Our strategy for Best-of-N methods consists of running independent single Oneshot iterations, and then composing a set of bootstrapped-trajectories B j = { T 1 j , … , T N j } B_{j}=\{T_{1}^{j},\ldots,T_{N}^{j}\} where each T i j T_{i}^{j} is a composition of multiple independent Oneshot iterations of the requested time limit budget.
sents.zh: 我们的最佳-N方法策略包括运行独立的单次Oneshot迭代，然后组合出一组自举轨迹 B j = { T 1 j , … , T N j } B_{j}=\{T_{1}^{j},\ldots,T_{N}^{j}\}，其中每个 T i j T_{i}^{j} 都是由请求的时间限制预算内多次独立的Oneshot迭代组合而成。

sents.en: Each trajectory is packed greedily so that the summed effective time of its iterations does not exceed the target budget, and an iteration that would overflow the trajectory is discarded rather than carried into the next one.
sents.zh: 每条轨迹都采用贪心方式打包，以确保其迭代的有效时间总和不超过目标预算；任何可能导致轨迹超时的迭代都会被丢弃，而不是延续到下一条轨迹中。

sents.en: The budget is therefore matched on the time the iterations actually consume, not on their nominal per-iteration time limit.
sents.zh: 因此，预算的匹配是基于迭代实际消耗的时间，而非其名义上的每次迭代时间限制。

sents.en: We can then extract all metrics for each trajectory T i j T_{i}^{j} by concatenating the submissions of all iterations in the trajectory.
sents.zh: 随后，我们可以通过将轨迹 T i j T_{i}^{j} 中所有迭代的提交结果拼接起来，提取出每条轨迹的所有指标。

sents.en: Finally, we sample multiple independent bootstrapped-trajectory sets B 1 , … , B M B_{1},\ldots,B_{M} and report the average-of-averages across this set.
sents.zh: 最后，我们采样多个独立的自举轨迹集合 B 1 , … , B M B_{1},\ldots,B_{M}，并报告该集合中各结果的平均值的平均值。

paragraphs.en: We ablate the effect of the per-iteration time limit in our default Oneshot experimental setting for DeepSeek V4 Pro (Preview) and GLM 5.2 models. Results are in Figure 6 . Nonetheless, the actual performance of the aggregated Best-of-N composites quickly saturates at the three hour mark. In our experimental setup, the six hour time limit default provides an reasonable choice to balance the performance and cost tradeoff. Note that, even when prompted to use the highest possible time budget of 12h, the agents still have a much lower average effective time usage, which is what allows us to aggregate Best-of-N at the 6h budget.

paragraphs.en: In Section 4 we observed that the gap of the performance between self-select (based on validation score) and oracle-best (based on actual test scores) becomes a problem, particularly for strategies that share less information between their iterations. In this section, we analyze three different interventions that can help mitigate such issue. Our experiment setting is on the default Oneshot iteration configuration (six hour per-iteration time limit, GLM 5.2), and the baseline behavior control is the Best-of-N aggregation at 12h budget setting. We compare:

paragraphs.en: Baseline iteration: At the beginning of the run, a Baseline iteration is spawned. The Baseline iteration aims to provide a simple, fast-to-run ML pipeline baseline to solve the task, while ensuring the validation split strategy follows a strict set of guidelines. Once this iteration ends, and until the 12h time limit, new Oneshot iterations use the Baseline’s workspace as starting point, while still remaining independent from each other. The goal for this intervention is to provide a common validation strategy for the iterations, and minimize the inconsistencies that come from differently designed sets.
paragraphs.zh: 基线迭代：在运行开始时，会生成一个基线迭代。 基线迭代旨在提供一个简单且运行迅速的机器学习流程基线以解决该任务，同时确保验证分割策略遵循严格的一套指导方针。 一旦此迭代结束，并且在 12 小时时间限制内，新的单次迭代将以基线的作业空间为起点，但彼此之间仍然保持独立。 此次干预的目标是为各迭代提供统一的验证策略，并尽量减少因不同设计集合而产生的不一致性。

paragraphs.en: Hidden validation: At the beginning of the iteration, the harness prepares a deterministic validation-train split from the training data, using MLE-bench’s data preparation scripts. The agent does not have access to the target predictions of the hidden validation split. This strategy has the drawback of reducing the total amount of training data available to train the model in the first place. Note that, as described, this strategy cannot be deployed in practice, due to the hard requirement of the deterministic splitter which would require human intervention, and is therefore reported as a ceiling of what pre-splitting strategies can achieve.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏验证：在迭代开始时，测试框架使用 MLE-bench 的数据准备脚本来从训练数据中生成一个确定性的验证-训练划分。 智能体无法访问隐藏验证划分中的目标预测结果。 这种策略的缺点是，会减少最初可用于训练模型的总训练数据量。 请注意，如所述，由于确定性划分器存在必须依赖人工干预的硬性要求，因此该策略在实践中无法部署，故被视作预划分策略所能达到的上限。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 shows the results of this experiment. We see that the base independent Best-of-N Oneshot configuration provides the best percentile ceiling (oracle), while the introduction of the strict validation guidelines in the prompt alone allows for a slightly better self-select performance, at the cost of also lowering the oracle ceiling. Finally, the introduction of the initial baseline iteration provides the smallest gap of all interventions ablated, at the cost of a significantly worse performance ceiling. A plausible mechanism for these differences is the comparability of the validation scores themselves, rather than the number of submissions available to choose from: a single session produces all of its candidates under one validation split, so their reported scores are mutually comparable, whereas independent Best-of-N iterations each design their own split and the harness is then asked to rank scores that were never on a common scale. The BI intervention is consistent with this reading, as it is the one that supplies a shared validation workspace. We report this as a hypothesis and not as a result: it predicts that the gap should grow with the number of distinct validation methodologies in the pool rather than with the number of submissions, which we do not test here. While these results provide a quick overview about possible validation gap mitigation strategies, we acknowledge that at our current statistical power level, we cannot make strong conclusions about these results, and we encourage a more in-depth future work in this direction, including on the mechanism above.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 展示了本次实验的结果。 我们看到，基础的独立“最佳 N 选一”单次运行配置提供了最高的百分位上限（oracle），而仅在提示中引入严格的验证指导方针，则能略微提升自我选择性能，但代价是 oracle 上限也会随之降低。 最后，引入初始基线迭代在所有被剔除的干预措施中产生了最小的差距，但代价是性能上限显著下降。 这些差异的一个合理解释机制在于验证分数本身的可比性，而非可供选择的提交次数：单次运行会在同一个验证分割下生成所有候选结果，因此其报告的分数具有相互可比性；而独立的“最佳 N 选一”迭代每次都会设计自己的验证分割，此时系统需要排序的分数从未处于同一衡量标准上。 BI 干预措施与这一解释一致，因为正是它提供了一个共享的验证工作区。 我们将此作为一个假设而非结果来报告：该假设预测，差距应随着池中不同验证方法的数量增加而扩大，而非提交次数的增加，但这一点我们在此并未测试。 尽管这些结果为可能的验证差距缓解策略提供了快速概览，但我们承认，在当前统计功效水平下，无法对这些结果得出强有力的结论；因此，我们鼓励未来在这一方向上进行更深入的研究，包括对上述机制的探讨。

paragraphs.en: We study how Malena scales under different time budgets. Our experimental setting consists of a DeepSeek V4 Pro (Preview) backbone, with a bare Malena iteration, meaning with the submission , system , and jobs tools disabled. This serves as the minimal harness over a coding agent. In our implementation, we use the submission tool to register the validation scores of each submission, and without it, we have no self-select mechanism. For this reason, in this section we report only the oracle ceiling score which, despite not being a production-ready configuration, still gives a realistic range of the temporal behavior of the agent, especially since the Malena iteration shows the lowest validation gap in our tested iterations (see Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了 Malena 在不同时间预算下的扩展表现。 我们的实验设置包括一个 DeepSeek V4 Pro（预览版）主干模型，并采用裸 Malena 迭代，即禁用了提交、系统和作业工具。 这构成了编码智能体的最小运行框架。 在我们的实现中，我们使用提交工具来记录每次提交的验证分数；若没有该工具，我们将缺乏自我选择机制。 因此，在本节中，我们仅报告“神谕上限”分数。尽管这一配置尚不具备实际部署条件，但它仍然能够反映智能体在时间维度上的行为范围，尤其是因为 Malena 迭代在我们测试的所有迭代中表现出最低的验证差距（参见附录 C.2）。
